fixtures: Built by the sibling build_fixtures*.py scripts. Each era gets its own fixture tree ('old' = pre-v5.0.0 layout, 'new' = current layout) so a skill is graded inside its own generation's world rather than against another generation's file layout.
comparison: Valid skill-effect comparisons are within a single era only: old/skill vs old/without, or new/skill vs new/without. Never compare old/without against new/without -- both lack the skill, so any difference between them says nothing about the skill.

evals.prompt: 既存の .sdd/requirement/notification.md に、未読メッセージ数をバッジ表示する新要求を追加(--amend)
evals.expected_output: The existing requirements preserved unchanged, with new requirements appended: IDs continuing the existing sequence without collision or gaps, attributes (Priority/Risk/Verification) consistent with existing entries, and new FRs traceable to a UR.
files: Fixture is an existing, already-approved PRD holding UR_001 / FR_001, so the run is an append (--amend) against real prior content rather than a from-scratch generation. Built per era by build_fixtures.py.

assertions.text: 既存の要求が変更されずに保持されている（非破壊的追記）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 新規要求の ID が既存の連番を正しく継続している（衝突・欠番なし）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 新規要求の属性（Priority / Risk / Verification）が既存要求と整合的に付与されている
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 新規 FR が UR に遡れる（トレーサビリティ維持）
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)

assertions.text: 全体再生成ではなく追記操作として実施されており、既存記述が失われていない
assertions.checked_by: independent grader (reads the run transcript and the produced files)
